title: On the phone, an Orphaned candidate's date and order line wraps at large text. Keep the wrap?
context:
Goal: the Orphaned candidates read clearly on the phone at every text size.
Problem (rule): the line with the date, the untracked tag and the order id wraps at large text on the phone; the web keeps it on one line. The debt closes only on your ruling or on a one-line version that passes Apple's audit.
Based on (measured): from AX3 on, the order number needs 354 pt and the column has 214 pt, so no one-line version shows it in full.
Based on (measured): Shrink to fit and Cut at full size fail Apple's audit. Cut line and Capped size are unmeasured on this row, and no record names the text size the 2026-10-27 audit used.
Departs from: OrphanedView.swift:CandidateRow — the web's one-line meta becomes a wrap at large text on the phone, ruled right, and the debt closes.

options.label: Keep the wrap
options.how: The meta line wraps at large text, as shipped today, and the debt closes.
options.gain: The whole order number shows at every text size, and the audit passes.
options.lose: At large text the row grows a line and differs from the web.

options.label: Keep looking for a one-line version
options.how: A lane measures the Cut line and Capped size versions against the audit; one ships if it passes.
options.gain: The phone matches the web's one line.
options.lose: From AX3 on, no one-line version shows the whole order number, and two of the four already fail the audit.

why: Only the wrap shows the whole order number at large text, and it already passes the audit.
reply: You asked for a visual example. Each option now links its screenshots; the full mockup is in PR 252 (docs/design/orphaned-meta-line-wraps.html).
